title: featurePlanImage
responsibility: Read a specific committed feature-plan option image for CLI review and register its command.

inputs.name: featurePlanImage.input
inputs.description: Selects the latest plan matching the reviewed digest, an exact page and option, and a new destination file.

inputs.name: featurePlanImage.dependencies
inputs.description: Trusted plan reader and planning image reader; defaults use the current project and real planning API.

inputs.name: registerFeaturePlanImage
inputs.description: Registers the CLI action with an injected image operation and output callback.

outputs.name: featurePlanImage
outputs.description: Reads the latest plan once; requires the supplied digest and page/option to match. Requests the option's exact unit, version, file, committed revision, hash and option from the planning reader, then atomically links its returned bytes to a new output file and removes its temporary directory. The real planning reader verifies image content and ownership. A later plan change during the read is not rechecked.

outputs.name: registerFeaturePlanImage
outputs.description: Registers image <feature> with required --page, --option, --digest and --output. Prints the saved path only after the image operation succeeds.

errors.name: invalid, stale or unavailable image
errors.description: Missing plan/page/option, stale digest, missing output, planning reader failure, existing destination or filesystem errors reject. An existing destination is never overwritten; temporary files are cleaned after a completed attempt.
